text.p: Following are the main headlines on Estonia's Kuku radio at midday. Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Estonian parliament member Olev Toomet was cleared of charges of fraud brought against him by members of the Estonian Pensioners' Association. The charges related to a raffle.
- Tallinn City Council is discussing the water supply and drainage authority's proposal to raise drinking and waste water prices for both the private and business sectors.

- Ferry workers from Saaremaa Ship AS, working between the mainland and Estonia's islands, are demanding a 70 percent pay increase. It is possible they will receive a 40 percent rise which will push ferry tariff prices up 10-20 percent.
